capture_status_note: Existing capture/index unresolved source-to-binary, dependency closure and wrapper archive roots remain unchanged; full scoped read is not global identity completion
sources_published_note: The public deliverable contains derived text, hashes and source locators only; no upstream raw source copies or binaries.

coverage.scope: All Connector src/main, src/mod and transformer text; root build/version settings and selected README/license/plugin/config/developer/probe docs. All Launchpad text including tests/fixtures/provenance/admin. All other bytes inventoried with explicit semantic exclusions.
coverage.line_count_method: Unicode splitlines includes non-newline-terminated final lines
coverage.full_read_attribution: Primary transformer/build review plus independently completed host and Launchpad full-text reviews; cited ranges and all byte hashes checked in this report pass

builtin_transformers.inference_limit: Expected comparator-respecting topological order, not an executed result or a claim about external plugins

patch_counts.meaning: Builder/generated declarations, not successful applications, supported mod counts or full external Adapter dynamic-patch coverage

lifecycle_contract.safeguard_failure: Prevents following pending cache confirmation in this path
lifecycle_contract.completion_limit: Entrypoint failure skips ordinary freeze/progress statements; actual outer invocation multiplicity untested
lifecycle_contract.pipeline_acceptance_limit: Connector offers converted files via addModFile but ignores boolean return before recording IDs/caches and removing stubs

findings.summary: Built-in FRONTIER chain has no explicit ANCHOR intermediary namespace-remapping stage; official-name/Class Tweaker assumptions and external plugins remain scoped boundaries
Launchpad owns opt-in metadata/nested/access/lifecycle integration; Connector stubs and transformed compatible outputs converge on its factory
Connector stub side filtering occurs late; ordinary Launchpad factory rejects wrong-side metadata before constructing ModFile
Cached and generated outputs have null audit; absence of a fresh failing audit does not certify runtime compatibility
NetworkRegistry allowMinecraftModdedPayload boolean body is identity; other hooks do change selected checks
Item-use helper is an adaptation landing point combining host helper and retargeted patch; null-return helper alone is not alternate use behavior
Cache version and input hash do not explicitly fingerprint all plugin/config/dependency inputs; no cache defect reproduced
Probe CLI success boolean is a transformation audit predicate; completed false result still returns zero exit code
